title: KANTO >=1000 HIGH-IMPACT UNRESEARCHED PREFLIGHT 2
scope: Only the 42 Kanto >=1,000 records still classified inventory-unresearched at start. Existing production, HOLD/NEED EVIDENCE/DEFER/HARD-CASE, aliases, and duplicates were excluded and not reread.
mode: preflight only: current first-party issuer research and formal triage; no two-pass transcription, source JSON, ranges, fingerprints, generated artifacts, or production integration.
evidencePolicy: Current first-party issuer material is the decision basis. Capacity is not seat evidence. Before checking a seat chart, each researched candidate was screened for operating status, closure, renovation, reconstruction, cessation, reopening, and whether a notice was space-specific or facility-wide. Under docs/VENUE_DATA_GUIDE.md, an officially announced closure or cessation within 12 months is a HOLD in principle; no exception is inferred. No capacity fitting, invented seat IDs, geometry completion, or third-party gap filling is permitted.

lane.name: JUDGMENT
lane.reason: The work selects issuer-defined representative configurations and applies a mandatory currentness screen before any prospective transcription; it makes no seat-map production decision.

method: Ranked only the remaining 42 inventory-unresearched records, using live/concert/theater search relevance, metropolitan impact, purpose-built hall/theater fit, and live official discovery signals for a current chart.
Favored a plausible complete issuer-numbered standard or fixed representative configuration over capacity alone.
Applied a yield penalty to stadiums, exhibition halls, standing-first rooms, and event-dependent arenas; none was excluded solely for venue type.
The ranking is a selection aid, not a formal disposition for any record not opened below.
